comparison.objective: Operate a spring-return coffee shelf, fill a mug, and return it safely to its saucer.
comparison.physical_skill: Shelf holding, vessel handling, control actuation, and spill avoidance; not adjuster manipulation or threaded locking.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports 120 ml retained, zero spill, no hot-stream/wall contact, and safe final placement, but omits the complete tiered numeric scorer.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated beverage service under spill and thermal constraints, not machinery commissioning.
